title: Controlled steady-state Clemson atmospheric microplastic plume experiments
status: Illustrative controlled meteorology and source assumptions; real receptor terrain; not a hindcast or ambient microplastic observation
time_basis: Eastern Standard Time UTC-5; hour-ending 01 through 24
calendar_interpretation: The year and date label a synthetic 24-hour experiment; they do not establish observed weather or measured microplastic emissions on that date

source.interpretation: Hypothetical diffuse vehicle-related tire-wear/resuspension area; assumed constant emission, not a measured facility or source inventory
source.illustrative_emission_derivation: 10000 assumed vehicles/day * 0.1 km segment * 0.1 g tire wear/(vehicle km) * 0.10 assumed airborne PM10 fraction = 10 g/day; neither traffic nor emission is measured at Clemson

particle.shape: Monodisperse equivalent-sphere surrogate; not explicit fiber/film/fragment aerodynamics
particle.diameter_note: Numerical equivalent-sphere diameter supplied to the density-dependent particle formula in AERMOD26135; do not additionally density-convert the input diameter

meteorology.status: Generated directly for controlled experiments; no AERMET execution or meteorological observations are claimed
meteorology.stability_interpretation: Near-neutral fixed weak-stable limit, positive L=1000000 m; not a Pasquill-class input
meteorology.precipitation_code_interpretation: IPCODE11 denotes liquid rain; IPCODE0 denotes no precipitation
meteorology.wind_comparison_caveat: Reference wind, derived friction velocity and tiny consistent heat flux vary between speed cases; L, roughness, mixing height, temperature, direction and all other specified conditions are fixed. Every field is time invariant within a case.
meteorology.profile_interpretation: One top-of-profile measurement at 10 m; model derives vertical profiles. Temperature is dry-adiabatically adjusted from the 2 m reference to 10 m. Sigma-theta and sigma-w missing sentinels99 request model derivation; unstable-only quantities use EPA missing sentinels and are not required for positive L.

output_units.hourly_dry_deposition: ug/m2 per one-hour interval; numerically ug/m2/h flux
output_units.hourly_wet_deposition: ug/m2 per one-hour interval; numerically ug/m2/h flux
output_units.file_format: OU FILEFORM EXP, native E13.6 scientific notation

terrain_grid_interpretation: Real AERMAP terrain at all receptors; merged original nested grid and refined eastward plume grid
